title: On the Fairness of Normalized p-Means for Allocating Goods and Chores
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical study in the field of fair division (computational social choice). It defines and analyzes 'normalized p-mean' objectives for resource allocation. Although it discusses 'fairness' and 'welfare', these are technical mathematical definitions (e.g., proportionality, envy-freeness) used in economic theory and are not related to religious or philosophical ethics or moral benchmarking of AI systems.
